questions.question:
How many rectangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90f1b939b03750d3d11eb34207e5026a992f8a5172d818f831f263f273c9bca2.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/LtGj6bPC3MU4pCFyLnXBpJVwZXVDMBz5wS3reWirRd7PjjRdlDLz-8Jk5zgwQryUyr9ar6_fLYm3XChgSRobFdSvoPg--RujRdwN-RyMXKU0RmHwghjTePQ0wqYiRe6hUJA_i3Ry] 

__Formula used for equal number of rows and column:__

Total number of rectangle ⇒ (n)3 + (n-1)³ + (n-2)³

n → number of rows/column

__Formula used for unequal number of rows and column:__

Total number of rectangle ⇒ (1 + 2 +......+ R) x (1 + 2 + .....+ C)

R → number of rows.

C → number of columns.

In this problem, the number of rows and column are equal.

n = 3

So, the number of rectangle in this figure = (3)³ + (3-1)³ + (3-2)³

⇒ 27 + 8 + 1

⇒ 36 = **36**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/zJZD7BEBrN9Ya0T0v4dpvMca5Wsxk8Ltg6-BUuvQeTk_5yz97OF41ZQbfJAHKq5PHc7e6afaJl7yuG7CPmRQCQqsTqQrTkn_0taBZWGLdwPgrB5YyfJrTzFcqbUEHrhJUh7tsExt] 

**__The number of rectangles in the given figure is shown below:__**

Hence, ‘36' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements is followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some tables are large.

II. No large is blue.

**Conclusions:**

I. All large are tables.

II. Some blue are large.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab802fb2c004d8251efa8893c7cb27ad599825c350fe07c6c409a1ab30d6ab29.png] 

I. All large are tables. → False (As, Some tables are large → So, some large are tables)

II. Some blue are large → False (As, No large is blue. → So, Some blue are not large)

Hence, neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows.

questions.question: Deepak is 45 years old and Raj is 60 years old. How many year ago was the ratio of their ages 7 : 10?
questions.solution:
Deepak is 45 years old and Raj is 60 years old.

Let ‘a’ years ago was the ratio of their ages 7 : 10.

According to question:

frac{{45 - a}}{{60 - a}} = (7)/({10)}

=> 450 – 10a = 420 – 7a

=> 450 – 420 = 10a – 7a

=> 30 = 3a

=> 10 = a

So, ’10’ years ago was the ratio of their ages 7 : 10.

Hence, ‘10’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: What will be the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 16000 for 2 years at the rate of 10% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Principal = Rs. 16000

Time = 2 years

Rate = 10%

**Formula**

Amount = P(1 + R/100)T

**Calculation**

Amount = 16000(1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount = 16000 × (11/10)²

⇒ Amount = 19,360

∴ Compound interest = Amount - Principal = 19360 - 16000 = Rs. 3360.

__**Smart Trick**__

Effective rate = x + y + (xy/100) = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

∴ Compound interest = 16000 × (21/100) = 3360.
